entities.name: Aldon
entities.description: Young man from Dominaria who lost his castle to the wizard Dreygar and summoned creatures to regain it.

entities.name: Dreygar
entities.description: Wizard who took Aldon's castle and was killed by Aldon.

entities.name: Serra Angel
entities.description: Angel summoned by Aldon who shows him the beauty of the world and perishes in battle.

entities.name: Fallen angel
entities.description: Angel sent by Dreygar to seduce Aldon, killed by Aldon.

events.summary: Aldon loses his castle to the wizard Dreygar.
events.quote: lost his castle to the wizard Dreygar

events.summary: Aldon summons a Sengir vampire, a frozen shade and a bog wraith to help regain his castle.
events.quote: He summons a Sengir vampire , a frozen shade , and a bog wraith

events.summary: Aldon summons a Serra Angel who shows him the beauty of the world.
Dreygar sends a fallen angel to seduce Aldon.
events.quote: Dreygar then sends a fallen angel to seduce Aldon.

events.summary: Aldon and his creatures assault the castle; Aldon kills the fallen angel and Dreygar and rules his castle again, but the Serra Angel perishes.
events.quote: Aldon kills the fallen angel and Dreygar, and once again rules his castle.

relations.note: Aldon kills Dreygar in the assault.
relations.quote: Aldon kills the fallen angel and Dreygar
lost his castle to the wizard Dreygar
